verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python library you install and run in your own process/infrastructure — docs describe the agent running 'behind a web frontend, in the terminal, on a voice call, on a durable background queue, or as a plain object you call run() on,' implying it is inherently self-hostable rather than a hosted SaaS. Missing for 10: explicit statement of open-source license/GitHub repo, and dedicated self-hosting/deployment documentation (e.g., Docker, infra guides).
